v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Stabunt iusti in magna constántia advérsus eos qui se angustiavérunt et qui abstulérunt labóres eórum.
text.en: Then shall the just stand with great constancy against those that have afflicted them, and taken away their labours.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Fíliæ Ierúsalem, * veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Daughters of Jerusalem, * come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui per stultítiam crucis eminéntem Iesu Christi sciéntiam beátum Iustínum Mártyrem mirabíliter docuísti: eius nobis intercessióne concéde; ut, errórum circumventióne depúlsa, fídei firmitátem consequámur.
text.en: O God, Who through the preaching of the Cross, which is to them that perish foolishness, didst wonderfully teach unto thy blessed martyr Justin the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus Our Lord, grant unto us at his prayers the grace to cast off all false teaching and ever to hold fast to the faith.

title.la: Ss. Tiburtii, Valeriani, et Maximi Martyrum
title.en: Sts. Tiburtius, Valerian et Maximus, Martyrs

text.la: Lux perpétua lucébit Sanctis tuis, Dómine, et ætérnitas témporum, allelúia.
text.en: Eternal light will shine over your saints, O Lord, and the eternity of times, alleluia.

v.la: Sancti et iusti in Dómino gaudéte, allelúia.
v.en: Saints and just, rejoice in the Lord, alleluia.

r.la: Vos elégit Deus in hereditátem sibi, allelúia.
r.en: The Lord has chosen you for his inheritance, alleluia.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Tibúrtii, Valeriáni et Máximi sollémnia cólimus; eórum étiam virtútes imitémur.
text.en: Almighty God, for Whom holy Tiburtius, Valerian, and Maximus uplifted their testimony, grant, we beseech Thee, unto all whosoever call the same to solemn memory, grace to imitate the example of their godly courage.
